concepts.title: Calm Precision — Login
concepts.prompt_direction: Bright split-screen companion with a subtle network field, indigo action, and only the AI scope plus one trust line.
concepts.strength: Highly legible and clearly related to the light workbench.
concepts.tradeoff: The split layout is conventional, though much more polished than the current card.

concepts.title: Midnight Operations — Login
concepts.prompt_direction: Minimal dark gateway with one restrained orbit motif, cyan focus states, and no footer, feature grid, or duplicated security claims.
concepts.strength: Strongest end-to-end product continuity with the dark Agent cockpit.
concepts.tradeoff: Needs disciplined dark-mode form and autofill styling across browsers.

concepts.title: Focused Canvas — Login
concepts.prompt_direction: Warm asymmetric authorization canvas with coral action, shared dark rail, and the layered-paper seed illustration.
concepts.strength: Warmest and most ownable account experience.
concepts.tradeoff: The shared rail makes the authorization screen feel more application-like than neutral OAuth.
